title: unitpopup
summary: MSUI now carries the 1.12 menu-table model (UnitPopupUiLaw): SELF/PARTY/PLAYER menus with Whisper (chat prefill), Invite/Uninvite/Promote-to-leader/Leave-party and leader-only party-to-raid conversion (CMSG_GROUP_* senders), Inspect and Trade (both interact-distance grayed), the cancel-only-menu refusal, and UnitPopup_HideButtons cooperate/leader/raid-state gating. The MENU-mode surface uses the vanilla tooltip backdrop, compact text rows, adaptive width, viewport clamping, click-away dismissal, and the reference 5-second hover-away timeout. Opened from player-frame/target-frame authored HitRectInsets, party frames, and world right-clicks. Still deferred, hidden per the reference deferral pattern: Follow (no follow system), Duel (no duel protocol family), loot-method/threshold submenus, raid target icons, and the dedicated RAID-member menu. Live-verified 2026-08-09 against a partybot (dumps/gameplay-bot-gear-clear.png).

openItems.text: SELF menu now opens with Leave party, but the loot method/threshold submenus and loot-promote rows are still deferred (no CMSG_LOOT_METHOD sender)
No party-management rows: Invite, Uninvite, Promote, Leave
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-09: UnitPopupUiLaw menus + CMSG_GROUP_INVITE/UNINVITE_GUID/SET_LEADER/DISBAND wired through OpenUnitPopup; leader-gated per UnitPopup_HideButtons.
2026-08-09: Whisper row opens the chat edit prefilled '/w Name ' (ChatFrame_SendTell equivalent), caret parked at end.

openItems.text: Follow row was a dead stub; now hidden outright (reference deferral pattern) until a follow movement mode exists — see systems/ui_follow
Trade row is not distance-gated (ref grays it beyond 11.11yd; only Inspect is gated in MSUI)
No auto-timeout/hover-away close; the card look is bespoke buttons rather than the vanilla menu rows
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-13: UnitPopup now renders compact MENU-mode text rows over the vanilla UI-Tooltip backdrop, sizes to its content, clamps to the viewport, dismisses on click-away, and keeps the reference 5-second hover-away timeout.
